title: Combat Woodblock Graphic Silhouette Explainer

identity.world: Original Combat Woodblock: warm fibrous paper, deep indigo, rust, ochre, carved contours, and flat registered colour.
identity.foreground: Original Graphic Silhouette: filled two-dimensional cutout anatomy, thick dark contour, 1–3 colour regions, one readable gesture.
identity.editorial: Original local evidence and information surfaces attached to intentional page, scroll, panel, or empty field geometry.

style_atoms.purpose: Establish a stable place and period.
Carry a readable human choice or emotion at phone size.
Display verified facts without generated text.

prompt_core: Original illustrated editorial scene: a stable Combat Woodblock world with warm fibrous paper, deep indigo, rust, ochre, carved contours, and flat registered colour. Add one simple Graphic Silhouette foreground actor with filled two-dimensional anatomy, a thick dark outline, a single clear grounded gesture, and one meaningful prop or environmental action. Leave deliberate clean space for locally composited information. No text in the image.
negative_constraints: no creator names or imitation language
no generated text, dates, citations, logos, flags, maps, or charts
no extra limbs, fused hands, floating actor, or implausible object contact
no gray generic text box or blank book as an information substitute
no full-frame camera shake or moving background plate
